Simisear

Fire

Unova · Generation 5

Simisear is a Fire-type Ember Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 28 kg. It evolves from Pansear. Its highest base stat is Speed (101), with a base stat total of 498.
